_note: Small named places in every area (PlaceSpots, Selwyn 23 Oct: 'Detailed 6 regions, more places to explore each region'). Each spot is a real thing built where it stands (prop), a few metres to a few dozen from one of the area's locations (loc, ring = how far out it may be placed). look is what anyone sees, secret is what a closer look finds (said once, then remembered; it may teach knowledge, a clue of the running story chapter or a lore line), night is what is different after dark. chapter: the spot exists only while that story chapter is running or done (the ash marks of 'The Lamplighter's Trail'). The brain offers a spot she has not seen as something to go and look at, and a known one rarely, differently. Props: cairn, standing_stone, stone_bench, ruin_arch, well, spring, statue, tablet, crystal_cluster, mushroom_ring, log, lantern_post, shrine, lookout, chimes, book_stack, ash_mark.

sanctuary.name: the mossy bench behind the colonnade
sanctuary.look: a stone bench half swallowed by moss, worn smooth in two places where people sat for years
sanctuary.secret: two names are scratched under the seat, 'Aurel' and 'Isen', with a little circle between them

sanctuary.name: a fallen column top
sanctuary.look: a carved column top lying in the grass, far from any column that is still standing
sanctuary.secret: the carving is a ring of seven flames, the same count as the pond pattern

sanctuary.name: the old wayfinding cairn
sanctuary.look: a waist-high cairn of flat stones, the top one turned so its point aims north
sanctuary.secret: every stone has a tiny notch on the same side, someone built it as a compass
sanctuary.night: the notched sides face the brightest star

sanctuary.name: a little spring in the ruins
sanctuary.look: clear water bubbling up between three old paving stones
sanctuary.secret: the water is warm, as if something under the sanctuary is still awake
sanctuary.night: the water gives off a very faint glow

sanctuary.name: the chime post
sanctuary.look: a wooden post hung with small stone chimes that knock together in the wind
sanctuary.secret: one chime is newer than the rest, someone replaced a broken one not long ago

sanctuary.name: a ring of pale mushrooms
sanctuary.look: a perfect circle of pale mushrooms in the grass, about two steps across
sanctuary.secret: spells cast near it come back a little stronger, the ring drinks stray magic
sanctuary.night: the caps glow a soft blue

arcane_library.name: a toppled stack of books
arcane_library.look: a knee-high pile of books that slid off a shelf and was never put back
arcane_library.secret: the top book is a borrowing ledger, the last entry is in a neat hand and only says 'S., three volumes on light, returned never'

arcane_library.name: the reading nook under the stairs
arcane_library.look: a stone seat tucked under the stair, with a candle stub on the step beside it
arcane_library.secret: the candle stub is fresh, someone reads here at night

arcane_library.name: a tablet in the wall
arcane_library.look: a stone tablet set into the shelf wall, covered in tiny writing
arcane_library.secret: it lists the keepers of the sanctuary, Aurel's name is the last one, there is room for more

mentor_tower.name: the rock below the tower
mentor_tower.look: a flat rock jutting out of the slope with a long view over the forest
mentor_tower.secret: you can see the sanctuary, the lake and a thin line of smoke far to the north
mentor_tower.night: the lake's lanterns are a small gold patch in the dark

mentor_tower.name: a dry well at the tower's foot
mentor_tower.look: an old stone well with no rope and no bucket
mentor_tower.secret: a dropped pebble takes a long time to land, and it lands in water after all

mentor_tower.name: the leaning stone
mentor_tower.look: a tall stone leaning at an angle, as if it was pushed
mentor_tower.secret: the lean points straight at the summit far away, someone aimed it

whispering_woods.name: a hollow log
whispering_woods.look: a fallen trunk hollowed out by years of rain, big enough to crawl through
whispering_woods.secret: inside, someone has stacked dry kindling and left a flint, a traveller's emergency camp

whispering_woods.name: the fairy ring by the trail
whispering_woods.look: a circle of mushrooms just off the trail, the grass inside greener than outside
whispering_woods.secret: no footprints cross it, the deer walk around it
whispering_woods.night: the ring glows and the air inside hums

whispering_woods.name: a little wayshrine
whispering_woods.look: a small stone shrine no taller than a knee, with a niche for a candle
whispering_woods.secret: the niche holds a grey smudge in the shape of a snuffed flame, the candle's light was taken, not blown out

whispering_woods.name: the trail cairn
whispering_woods.look: a small cairn of river stones beside the trail
whispering_woods.secret: the stones are from the river, someone carried them up the hill one by one

whispering_woods.name: the bone-white chimes
whispering_woods.look: pale wooden chimes hanging from a low branch, clicking softly
whispering_woods.secret: they only sound when the wind comes from the north, they are a warning bell for storms

lantern_lake.name: the wish stone by the shore
lantern_lake.look: a smooth standing stone near the water, covered in small scratched marks
lantern_lake.secret: each mark is a tiny lantern, one for every wish someone sent across the lake
lantern_lake.night: the scratched lanterns catch the light of the real ones

lantern_lake.name: the bench in the reeds
lantern_lake.look: an old bench almost hidden by tall reeds, facing the water
lantern_lake.secret: it faces exactly where the first lanterns are let go every night

ancient_grove.name: the root arch
ancient_grove.look: an old stone arch so wrapped in roots that the tree seems to be holding it up
ancient_grove.secret: the keystone has a carved eye, and the eye has been scratched out with a blade

ancient_grove.name: the green spring
ancient_grove.look: a small pool of very green water fed from under a root
ancient_grove.secret: tiny glowing seeds drift in it and never sink
ancient_grove.night: the seeds light the pool from below

ancient_grove.name: a mossy guardian statue
ancient_grove.look: a weathered guardian figure, its face almost worn away
ancient_grove.secret: the hollow where its lantern eye sat is empty and ringed with grey ash, the light was lifted out

ancient_grove.name: the giant mushroom ring
ancient_grove.look: a ring of mushrooms as big as dinner plates around a mossy stone
ancient_grove.secret: the stone in the middle is warm, the mushrooms grow toward it

ancient_grove.name: the fallen giant's branch
ancient_grove.look: a branch as thick as a house wall, broken off the fallen giant
ancient_grove.secret: the rings inside are too many to count, this tree was old before the sanctuary was built

ancient_grove.name: a tablet at the shrine stair
ancient_grove.look: a cracked tablet leaning against the shrine stair
ancient_grove.secret: it says the grove was kept by 'lightkeepers' who carried one flame between all the old shrines

river_valley.name: the flat fishing rock
river_valley.look: a flat rock at the river's edge, polished by people sitting on it
river_valley.secret: glowing fish gather in its shadow, they like the shade

river_valley.name: a patch of dark reeds
river_valley.look: a stretch of the glowing reeds that has gone dark and grey
river_valley.secret: the dark patch is a perfect circle, as if a lantern was lowered into it and drank the glow

river_valley.name: the ford cairn
river_valley.look: a tall cairn on the bank marking the shallow crossing
river_valley.secret: notches on the top stone mark how high the river rose in past floods, the highest is above your head

river_valley.name: the bench in the spray
river_valley.look: a stone bench where the waterfall's spray drifts over
river_valley.secret: when the sun is right, a small rainbow sits over the bench

river_valley.name: crystals behind the falls
river_valley.look: a cluster of pale blue crystals growing where the spray never stops
river_valley.secret: they hum in tune with the falling water
river_valley.night: they glow in time with the water

village.name: the village notice board
village.look: a board covered in pinned notes, lost goats, a baker wanting help, a lantern festival poster
village.secret: a new note says 'Blue lamp oil sold out. A hooded traveller bought it all and paid in old silver. Her lantern gave no light.'

village.name: the wishing well
village.look: a second, older well behind the houses, its roof long gone
village.secret: the bottom is full of coins, and one of them is a mage's token from the academy

village.name: the oldest lantern post
village.look: an iron lantern post much older than the market around it
village.secret: its lantern never needs oil, it is lit by a tiny trapped spell
village.night: it burns a different colour than the market lanterns

village.name: the bench by the workshop
village.look: a bench in the sun by the workshop where the villagers take their breaks
village.secret: someone has carved a small cat into the armrest, and a real one sleeps there most days

village.name: the corner shrine
village.look: a tiny shrine at the end of the market with flowers left in it
village.secret: the flowers are fresh every morning, nobody admits to bringing them

observatory_hill.name: the stargazers' bench
observatory_hill.look: a long bench facing the sky, with star names carved along the back
observatory_hill.secret: two of the carved stars are not in any book, the keeper named them himself
observatory_hill.night: you can find both of his stars from here

observatory_hill.name: the summit marker
observatory_hill.look: a cairn marking the top of the hill
observatory_hill.secret: a brass plate on it shows the way to the summit temple, three days on foot

observatory_hill.name: the hill's edge
observatory_hill.look: a rocky edge with the whole village below
observatory_hill.secret: from here the village streets make the shape of a lantern

crystal_caverns.name: a cleanly cut crystal
crystal_caverns.look: a crystal cluster with one great spire missing
crystal_caverns.secret: the cut is glass smooth, no miner's tool did this, a spell sliced the light out of it

crystal_caverns.name: the miners' bench
crystal_caverns.look: a bench at the cave mouth with tally marks scratched along it
crystal_caverns.secret: the tallies stop on the same day, as if the miners all left at once

crystal_caverns.name: the echo stone
crystal_caverns.look: a smooth black stone standing alone among the crystals
crystal_caverns.secret: say a word to it and the crystals around repeat it, softer and softer

crystal_caverns.name: a crystal pool
crystal_caverns.look: a shallow pool with crystals growing up out of the water
crystal_caverns.secret: the water is so clear it looks empty until you touch it

deep_caverns.name: the shore cairn
deep_caverns.look: a cairn at the edge of the underground lake
deep_caverns.secret: it hides a sealed jar with a map of the caves inside, drawn by a careful hand

deep_caverns.name: a tablet beside the vault path
deep_caverns.look: a tablet half buried in rubble near the vault
deep_caverns.secret: it warns that the vault holds 'the first flame of the lightkeepers', and that it must never be carried out

deep_caverns.name: the shoreline crystals
deep_caverns.look: crystals lining the shore, their light reflected in the still water
deep_caverns.secret: their reflections in the lake are a different colour from the crystals themselves

highland_path.name: a scratched cairn
highland_path.look: a waymarker cairn with a grey smear across its top stone
highland_path.secret: the same snuffed flame sign again, and fresh boot prints heading up toward the summit

highland_path.name: the wind ledge
highland_path.look: a ledge where the wind pushes so hard you have to lean into it
highland_path.secret: below, the clouds part now and then and show a valley with no lights in it at all

highland_path.name: the prayer chimes
highland_path.look: chimes and faded cloth strips tied to a post at a bend in the path
highland_path.secret: each strip has a name on it, travellers who made it to the summit

highland_path.name: the shelter stone
highland_path.look: a low wall of stacked stone with a bench in its lee
highland_path.secret: someone slept here last night, the stones are still warm

celestial_summit.name: a cold campsite
celestial_summit.look: a small campsite tucked behind the temple wall, a bedroll and an iron lantern hanging dark
celestial_summit.secret: a letter under the lantern: 'To whoever follows me. My village of Duskmere lost every light the night its keeper died. I take only a little from each old flame. When the lantern is full I will go home and light it again. I am sorry. S.'

celestial_summit.name: the prayer stones
celestial_summit.look: a field of tiny stacked stones on the temple steps
celestial_summit.secret: the newest stack has a small grey feather on top, a phoenix feather

celestial_summit.name: the star tablet
celestial_summit.look: a stone tablet marked with constellations and lines between them
celestial_summit.secret: the lines connect the old shrines of every region, it is a map of the lightkeepers' road

celestial_summit.name: the cloud edge
celestial_summit.look: the very edge of the summit with nothing but cloud below
celestial_summit.secret: far to the north, past the clouds, one dark valley, Duskmere if the letter is true

academy.name: the academy notice board
academy.look: a stone board with exam lists, lost spellbooks and a club for night-sky studies
academy.secret: an old notice, 'Former student Sable Wren expelled for removing light from the practice crystals'

academy.name: the founder's statue
academy.look: a tall statue of a mage holding a lamp high, in the middle of the gardens
academy.secret: the plaque says the founder was a lightkeeper before the academy existed

academy.name: the bench by the fountain
academy.look: a stone bench where students leave folded paper notes for each other
academy.secret: one note is addressed to 'whoever finds this, good luck on your exam', a whole stack of kindness

academy.name: the arena's scorched stone
academy.look: a standing stone at the arena's edge, black with old scorch marks
academy.secret: every scorch mark has a name and a year chalked beside it, the best spells ever cast here

great_library.name: the returns cart
great_library.look: a pile of books waiting to be shelved
great_library.secret: three of them are on 'drawing light from old flames', each stamped overdue for a year, borrowed by S. Wren

great_library.name: the window seat
great_library.look: a deep window seat with cushions worn flat
great_library.secret: someone has written tiny notes in the margin of the window's stone frame, a whole conversation between two readers
